decisions.reason: Acceptance of a bulkier enclosure does not change the requirements for removable or easily cleaned bowls, spouts, and whisk components.
Allowing a bulkier enclosure does not alter the required bowl-removal clearance or rapid bowl-swapping workflow.
The enclosure-size decision has no necessary effect on the selected food-contact materials.
The cross-Requirement effect is already fully represented by the existing message-155 MODIFY, which accepts a bulkier enclosure and removes the obsolete preferred side-profile constraint.
Accepting additional enclosure bulk does not change whisk size, style, material, bowl-capacity compatibility, or positioning criteria.
The source decision relaxes an enclosure-size constraint but does not change the splash-control target or approved control methods.
The acceptance of a bulkier enclosure does not alter the required smoothness, foam quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The client only indicates that a different logo may be developed later; this does not change the currently confirmed placard text, faces, or placement requirements.
The larger enclosure accommodates internal solenoid and piping components but does not necessarily change the confirmed power source or electrical-capacity requirements.
Accepting a bulkier mixer enclosure does not modify the independently specified 12-ounce cup clearance or raised-base height.
The enclosure-size relaxation and tentative future logo work do not change the confirmed beige and green color scheme.
Although the added enclosure bulk is attributed to internal solenoid and piping, the source does not change any leak-prevention, sealing, or closed-valve drip requirement.
